title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Contradictory Witness, Evidence Ledger, and Contested-Truth Extension
revision_notes: Adds claim identity and evidence ledgers distinct from face memory.
Adds CONTESTED as a legitimate stable truth status when evidence is insufficient.
Prevents majority-of-faces voting from becoming epistemic authority.
Allows an external claim to be resolved without deleting a sincere but inaccurate memory.
Requires unresolved assumptions to remain visible in any time-sensitive commit that acts before truth resolution.

technical_primitives.CLAIM_ID: Stable identifier for one externally testable proposition.
technical_primitives.WITNESS_RECORD_ID: Identifier for a provenance-bound observation report.
technical_primitives.EVIDENCE_LEDGER: Append-only evidence collection for one or more claims.
technical_primitives.EVIDENCE_INDEPENDENCE_CLASS: Metadata describing whether evidence sources are causally independent, correlated, copied, or unknown.
technical_primitives.NEUTRAL_ANCHOR_RECEIPT: Evidence source not generated solely from the conflicting branch memories.
technical_primitives.DECISION_ASSUMPTION_REF: Exact unresolved claim assumption used by a commit made before epistemic resolution.

epistemic_pipeline: MEMORY_RECORD -> WITNESS_RECORD -> CLAIM -> EVIDENCE_LEDGER -> TRUTH_STATUS -> DECISION_ASSUMPTION_IF_NEEDED -> COMMIT -> WORLD_EFFECT_RECEIPT

compatibility_with_original_JANUS_113.PDR_04_SEPARATE_THE_CHANNELS: OBSERVATION, INFERENCE, CLAIM and VERIFIED_RESULT are now represented as distinct machine states.
compatibility_with_original_JANUS_113.PDR_08_NEUTRAL_ANCHOR: Neutral anchor becomes explicit evidence provenance rather than a narrative suggestion.
compatibility_with_original_JANUS_113.PDR_12_STOP_THE_LOOP: When evidence conflict escalates, stop epistemic promotion and external commit where possible; preserve both witnesses for audit.

minimum_tests: contradictory witness records can coexist without one being erased
truth status remains CONTESTED when no resolving evidence exists
100 copied faces do not outweigh one independent receipt merely by count
external evidence may resolve a claim while preserving losing witness history
commit under unresolved truth records its assumptions
later evidence can update truth status without rewriting the old commit receipt
tamper_tests: change a witness record after claim resolution
delete losing witness to fabricate unanimity
rewrite truth status without evidence receipt
hide contested assumption from an external commit

en: A memory is a witness record, not a verdict about the world.
Two sincere witnesses may disagree without either being deleted from identity.
Truth is not elected by face count.
Resolve the claim with evidence; preserve the history of who believed what and why.
When action cannot wait for certainty, uncertainty itself must enter the commit receipt.
